_meta.how_verified: Roblox public web APIs only (no Studio, no auth). economy.roblox.com/v2/assets/<id>/details for AssetTypeId/name/creator; apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service for search + decal->image (textureId) resolution; thumbnails.roblox.com for visual inspection.
_meta.important_limitation: assetdelivery.roblox.com now answers 401 "Authentication required" for almost every third-party asset (images, decals, models, meshes). Only assets owned by Roblox / Roblox staff art accounts (Roblox, RBLXImagineer, Crykee) still download anonymously. So entries marked verification=thumbnail-only could NOT have their real bytes, exact pixel size or file format checked: width/height are null and preview_width/preview_height are the size of the Roblox-rendered thumbnail (max 768x432 or 700x700, aspect ratio preserved, alpha preserved). Every such image was looked at on contact sheets, its AssetTypeId is 1 (Image) and Roblox serves a rendered thumbnail for it (state Completed).
_meta.id_kind: All image entries are IMAGE asset ids (AssetTypeId 1), resolved from free Creator Store decals. Use as rbxassetid://<id>.
_meta.runtime_risk: Whether a third-party image loads inside your experience could not be tested from outside Studio. All came from decals listed free+published on the Creator Store, but confirm in Studio that each id renders; fall back to "alternates" if one does not. Entries by Roblox/RBLXImagineer/Crykee are the safest.
_meta.wrap_seam_ratio: For equirectangular maps: mean colour difference between the left and right edge columns divided by the mean difference between neighbouring columns. ~1 = tiles seamlessly; all primaries were also inspected rolled by 50% and show no visible seam.
_meta.tinting: Greyscale/white entries (ring_white, ring_thin, extra_gas_giant_grey, accretion_disk, smoke_cloud, glow_soft) are meant to be coloured in code (ImageColor3 / Decal.Color3 / SpecialMesh.VertexColor / ParticleEmitter.Color).

sphere_mesh.name: RenderMesh
sphere_mesh.creator: RBLXImagineer
sphere_mesh.source: MeshId found inside the Roblox-owned model 10980780693 "Space Station Architecture Pack - Beyond the Dark"
sphere_mesh.uv_details: Exact lat/long mapping (max error 5e-7): v = 0 at the +Y pole (top row of the image) and v = 1 at the -Y pole; u = atan2(x, z)/(2*pi) + 0.2 (mod 1), increasing to the right when seen from outside, so maps are not mirrored. u spans the full 0..1 with duplicated seam vertices (no wrapped triangles). 20 longitude segments x 20 latitude bands.
sphere_mesh.normals: smooth, pointing outward; triangle winding outward (renders from outside).
sphere_mesh.verification: full-download: mesh file parsed (positions, normals, UVs, faces, LODs) and software-rendered with the terra map (preview/sphere_mesh_render.png, preview/sphere_mesh_uv.png).
sphere_mesh.notes: Use as SpecialMesh{MeshType=FileMesh, MeshId="rbxassetid://6441034336", TextureId="rbxassetid://<map>", Scale=Vector3.one*(R/8.00446)} for a sphere of radius R studs (SpecialMesh ignores the Part size). Only 20 segments around, so the silhouette is a 20-sided polygon and looks slightly faceted on very large planets; shading is smooth. If MeshPart is used instead, Size = Vector3.one*(2R).

skybox_hub.name: this should work
skybox_hub.creator: SniperMyBeloved
skybox_hub.verification: thumbnail-only (700x700 thumbnails of all 6 faces inspected). Cube-edge continuity measured: mean edge colour difference with this assignment = ring 1.76 / Up 1.23 / Dn 2.08 (0-255 scale; mismatched assignments score 17.1+).
skybox_hub.notes: Blue-violet nebula with pink/purple cloud core, blue wisps and dense star field. Hub pick. FACE ASSIGNMENT: the ids are already mapped to Roblox Sky properties so that the cube is seamless in Roblox - this is NOT the uploader's naming. Roblox's own classic skies (8 Roblox-owned Sky models checked by edge matching) use: turning right from SkyboxFt you see SkyboxLf, then Bk, then Rt; SkyboxUp's right edge joins Ft's top edge; SkyboxDn's right edge joins Ft's bottom edge. The uploader named faces in the ordinary cross layout (front/right/back/left), so the seamless mapping is Ft=their "right", Lf=their "back", Bk=their "left", Rt=their "front", Up=their "top", Dn=their "bottom". Assigning by name (front->Ft, left->Lf ...) would show seams on every edge. Set Sky.CelestialBodiesShown=false and StarCount=0 if the built-in stars/sun clash.
